question: The Vadhavan Port is located in _______.
solution:
The correct answer is Maharashtra.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vadhavan Port** is located on the** west coast of India**, in the state of** Maharashtra.**
 
• It is situated between** Dahanu and Jawaharlal Nehru Port (JNPT)** and is a deep-water port.
 
• The port is being developed as a part of the** Sagarmala project,** which aims to modernize India's ports and connect them to the country's hinterland through road, rail, and waterways.
 
• The Vadhavan Port project is expected to cost around Rs. **10,000 crore **and will have a capacity of handling** 60 million tonnes of cargo** per annum once completed.
 
• It is expected to cater to industries in **Maharashtra, Gujarat, and North India.** 
 
• The port is being developed by the** Jawaharlal Nehru Port Trust (JNPT) **in collaboration with the **Maharashtra Maritime Board (MMB)** and is expected to be operational by** 2023.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kerala:**

 
 
• Kerala has several ports, including the **Kochi Port**, which is one of the major ports in India.
 
• It is located in** Kochi,** which is the commercial capital of Kerala.
 
 
 
• **Tamil Nadu:**
 
 
• Tamil Nadu also has several ports, including the** Chennai Port and the Ennore Port.**
 
• Chennai Port is one of the **oldest ports** in India and is located in the city of Chennai.
 
 
 
• **West Bengal:**
 
 
• West Bengal has two major ports, the** Kolkata Port and the Haldia Por**t.
 
• The Kolkata Port is the oldest operating port in India and is located in the city of** Kolkata.**
 
• The Haldia Port is located around **50 km downstream of Kolkata Port** and is a major riverine port.
